questions.stem: Rajesh invests \(10{,}000\) in Scheme A at \(12\%\) p.a. (CI) and \(15{,}000\) in Scheme B at \(10\%\) p.a. (CI), both for \(2\) years. What is the total compound interest earned?

Equal sums are invested for \(2\) years: Scheme P at \(15\%\) p.a. (CI) and Scheme Q at \(14\%\) p.a. compounded half-yearly. If the difference in the two interests is \(346\), how much was invested in each scheme?
questions.keySolution:
Let investment in each scheme be \(P\).
CI\(_P\)=\(0.3225P\), CI\(_Q\)=\(0.3108P\)
Difference \(=0.0117P=346\Rightarrow P\approx29{,}600\)

questions.stem: Mohan invests \(8{,}000\) at \(20\%\) p.a. (CI) for \(1\) year and \(12{,}000\) at \(15\%\) p.a. (SI) for \(2\) years. Find the total interest earned.

A sum is divided in the ratio \(2:3\). The first part is invested at \(10\%\) p.a. (CI) and the second at \(12\%\) p.a. (CI), both for \(2\) years. If the total CI is \(4{,}680\), find the original sum.
Priya invests \(5{,}000\) each in three schemes for \(3,2,1\) years at \(8\%\), \(10\%\), \(12\%\) p.a. respectively (CI). Which scheme yields the highest CI?
An investor puts \(25{,}000\) at \(16\%\) p.a. compounded quarterly and \(20{,}000\) at \(18\%\) p.a. compounded half-yearly, both for \(1\) year. What is the combined amount at maturity?
Out of \(30{,}000\), a part is invested at \(10\%\) p.a. (CI) and the rest at \(15\%\) p.a. (CI) for \(2\) years. If the total CI is \(7{,}350\), how much is invested at \(10\%\)?
Suresh invests \(8{,}000\) at \(12\%\) p.a. (CI) for \(3\) years and \(6{,}000\) at \(8\%\) p.a. (SI) for \(4\) years. What is the ratio of compound to simple interest?

A businessman invests \(20{,}000\) at \(10\%\) p.a. (CI), \(15{,}000\) at \(12\%\) p.a. compounded half-yearly, and \(25{,}000\) at \(8\%\) p.a. (SI), all for \(2\) years. Find the total interest earned.

Two friends invest \(12{,}000\) and \(18{,}000\) at \(15\%\) p.a. (CI) for \(1\) year, then reinvest their amounts at \(10\%\) p.a. (CI) for another \(2\) years. What is the difference in their final amounts?

A woman splits \(40{,}000\) into two parts: one at \(8\%\) p.a. compounded quarterly and the other at \(10\%\) p.a. compounded annually, both for \(2\) years. If both parts amount to the same figure, find the first part.
A loan of \(50{,}000\) at \(12\%\) p.a. (CI) is partly repaid by \(20{,}000\) after 1 year and \(25{,}000\) after 2 years. How much must be paid at the end of the 3rd year to clear the debt?
Partners A, B, C invest \(15{,}000\), \(20{,}000\), \(25{,}000\) for \(2\) years at \(10\%\), \(12\%\), \(8\%\) p.a. respectively (CI). Find their total profit.

A scholarship of \(25{,}000\) is invested at \(6\%\) p.a. compounded quarterly for \(2\) years. One year later another \(30{,}000\) is added at \(8\%\) p.a. (CI) for \(1\) year. What is the total amount after the second year’s end?
For \(50{,}000\) over \(2\) years, Scheme X offers \(14\%\) p.a. (CI, yearly) while Scheme Y offers \(13.5\%\) p.a. compounded half-yearly. Which is better and by how much?
